## About
Engine Works is a car repair and maintenance shop at 1923 Minturn St. in Alameda, run by owner and operator Eric Quan.
Neighbors bring us everything from family cars to work vans. Reviewers tell us they come back for honest opinions, work that holds up, and a crew that keeps them updated while the job is in progress.
We hold a 4.7 rating from 93 Google reviews, and many of our customers find us through friends, neighbors and other shops on the island.

## Services
- Cylinder head and valve cover repair: Repairing these parts when other shops only want to replace them.
- Tricky, intermittent problems: Tracking down hard to find issues that other shops have given up on.
- Brakes and transmission repair: Brake work and transmission repair for the family car.
- Oil changes and electronic evaluations: Regular maintenance plus electronic evaluation and repair.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I book an appointment?
A: You can book online through our website or call us at 510-523-6779.

Q: Do you have coupons?
A: Yes. Our website has coupons you can print and bring in.

- "Took my partners 99 Miata to them, it had overheated and blew a head gasket.

Service was fast and thorough, communication was great, they kept me appraised of the progress and status throughout.

And as for the price, it was very reasonable given the scope of the work." (andrew custer, 5/5)
